meta.title: Private dining & catering
meta.description: Private rooms and the whole roof at Zill, menus written for the occasion, and catering at your place.

privateDining.title: A courtyard of your own
privateDining.intro: Birthdays, family gatherings, quiet business dinners, the eve of a wedding: a room or the whole roof, a menu written for the occasion, and a host who stays with you all evening.

inquiry.title: Tell us about the occasion
inquiry.body: Our events host replies within a day with availability, a menu and a quote.
inquiry.messageHint: The occasion, dietary needs, timings, a budget…
inquiry.done: Thank you — our events host will write to {email} within a day.
inquiry.dateHint: Leave empty if the date is not fixed yet.

errors.roomSize: {room} holds up to {count, plural, one {{n} guest} other {{n} guests}}.
errors.minGuests: {package} starts at {count, plural, one {{n} guest} other {{n} guests}}.

privateDining.roomsIntro: Three rooms across the two houses, each closed to everyone but your table. The host plans the evening with you: the menu, the hour, the flowers, the music or the silence.
privateDining.packagesIntro: Starting points rather than fixed menus: the kitchen adjusts each one to the season, to your guests and to the hour you choose.
privateDining.cateringIntro: When the gathering is at your home, your majlis or your office, the house travels: the pots, the bread, the coffee and the people who serve it.

steps.title: Tell us
steps.body: The date, the number of guests and the occasion. A rough idea is enough.

steps.title: We reply within a day
steps.body: With the rooms free that evening, a suggested menu and a quote per guest.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.body: A deposit holds the room; the menu is settled a week before, allergies included.

steps.title: The evening
steps.body: Your host stays with your table from the first coffee to the last glass of tea.

meta.title: Gift cards
meta.description: Give an hour of shade: Zill gift cards, delivered by email now or on the day you choose, for either house or online.
